summary.en: Markets navigate Middle East escalation risk amid inflation fears; 10Y yields retreat to 4.64% as bond pricing wariness grows. Nvidia earnings tomorrow anchors tech attention, while geopolitics keeps energy elevated despite oil dips on peace-talk headlines.
summary.zh: 市场在中东局势升级风险与通胀担忧间寻找平衡；10 年期美债收益率退至 4.64%，债市谨慎情绪升温。英伟达明早财报成为科技板块焦点，地缘政治支撑油价高位。

title.en: Iran threatens to extend conflict 'beyond region' if U.S. resumes attacks
title.zh: 伊朗威胁将冲突扩大至区域外，若美国重启对德黑兰的打击

impact.en: Middle East escalation risk re-prices oil and inflation expectations. Rev Guard warns of crushing blows if aggression repeats. Market remains wary despite Trump's peace-talk narrative.
impact.zh: 中东升级风险重新定价油价和通胀预期。伊斯兰革命卫队警告，若美国继续施压将付出惨痛代价。市场仍对特朗普的和平谈判叙事保持警惕。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Geopolitical escalation risks fueling oil prices and inflation expectations. Potential supply disruption if Hormuz Strait remains closed.
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 地缘政治升级风险推高油价和通胀预期。霍尔木兹海峡若继续关闭，供应中断风险犹存。

title.en: US Treasury yields retreat as bond markets price 'significant' inflation risk
title.zh: 美债收益率回落，债市押注'显著'通胀风险

impact.en: 10Y yield slipped to 4.639% from Tuesday's 4.687% high. 30Y bond at 5.164%. Fed's April FOMC minutes show 8-4 split on rates. Sticky inflation threatens to complicate Fed's pivot.
impact.zh: 10 年期收益率从周二 4.687% 高位回落至 4.639%。30 年期国债至 5.164%。美联储 4 月会议纪要显示利率决策分歧。顽固通胀恐使美联储转向复杂化。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Inflation expectations rising could force Fed to hold rates longer. HSBC warns Treasurys in 'danger zone' from sticky inflation.
macroRisk.zh: 是 - 通胀预期上升可能迫使美联储维持利率更久。HSBC 警告美债陷入'危险区'，因通胀顽固。

title.en: Oil dips 1-2% after Trump promises quick Iran war end
title.zh: 特朗普承诺快速结束伊朗战争后油价回调 1-2%

impact.en: WTI down 1.1% to $103, Brent to $110. Market gauges deal viability despite Chinese tankers exiting Hormuz. Supply won't normalize post-war quickly. Oil volatility elevated.
impact.zh: WTI 跌 1.1% 至 103 美元，布伦特至 110 美元。市场在评估协议可行性，尽管中国油轮已驶离霍尔木兹。战后供应不会快速恢复正常。油价波动率仍高。

macroRisk.en: No - Price move is tactical. Geopolitical premium remains embedded. Watch for deal failure or supply disruption.
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 价格调整属战术性。地缘溢价仍内嵌。关注协议失败或供应中断风险。

title.en: Nvidia earnings tomorrow: Will it form $6T market cap club?
title.zh: 英伟达明早财报：能否加入 6 万亿美元市值俱乐部？

impact.en: Fiscal 2027 Q1 results expected to show AI chip demand resilience. Stock up 20% pre-earnings. UBS raised target ahead of strong revenue forecast. AI infrastructure spending remains robust.
impact.zh: 预计财政 2027 年 Q1 财报显示 AI 芯片需求韧性。股价盘前已涨 20%。UBS 在强收入预期前上调目标。AI 基础设施支出依然强劲。

macroRisk.en: No - Company-specific event. AI mega-cap earnings anchor tech sentiment.
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 公司级事件。AI 巨头财报锚定科技板块情绪。

title.en: AMD lags amid Nvidia earnings shadow over semiconductor trade
title.zh: AMD 受英伟达财报阴影拖累，半导体板块交易滞后

impact.en: AMD down 1.6% as NVDA earnings overshadow chip sector. Investors weigh relative AI chip valuations. AMD holds market share but trades on NVDA narrative momentum.
impact.zh: AMD 跌 1.6%，受 NVDA 财报笼罩。投资者权衡 AI 芯片相对估值。AMD 虽持市场份额，但交易取决于 NVDA 叙事动量。

macroRisk.en: No - Relative sector positioning. NVDA momentum vs. AMD execution.
macroRisk.zh: 否 - 板块相对定位。NVDA 动量与 AMD 执行力对比。

ai.en: AI chip demand remains robust ahead of Nvidia earnings. Infrastructure spending continues despite valuation concerns. AMD lags on NVDA momentum but holds position.
ai.zh: 英伟达财报前 AI 芯片需求依然强劲。基础设施支出持续，尽管估值存疑。AMD 受 NVDA 动量拖累但保持地位。

semiconductor.en: Sector trades cautiously ahead of Nvidia. NVDA earnings anchor sentiment. AMD down 1.6% on shadow. Memory and server chips follow NVDA narrative.
semiconductor.zh: 板块在英伟达财报前谨慎交易。NVDA 财报锚定情绪。AMD 受阴影拖累跌 1.6%。存储和服务器芯片跟随 NVDA 叙事。

bigTech.en: Big Tech follows AI infrastructure spending. Microsoft/Google cloud AI spend remains elevated. AI monetization progress key catalyst. Mixed sentiment post-China tensions.
bigTech.zh: 大科技跟随 AI 基础设施支出。微软/谷歌云 AI 支出保持高位。AI 变现进展是核心催化剂。中事后情绪分化。

energy.en: Oil prices elevated despite tactical dip on peace-talk headlines. Brent ~$109, WTI ~$102. Geopolitical premium embedded. OIH, USO benefit from premium. XOM, COP trade on supply constraints.
energy.zh: 油价在和平谈判头条后战术性回调但仍处高位。布伦特约 109 美元，WTI 约 102 美元。地缘溢价内嵌。OIH、USO 受益于溢价。XOM、COP 交易供应限制。

ev.en: EV sector cautious amid energy volatility and chip constraints. Stellantis turnaround plan unveiled. Supply chain normalization post-geopolitics key. Tesla monitors energy costs.
ev.zh: EV 板块在能源波动和芯片约束下谨慎。Stellantis turnaround 计划公布。地缘政治后供应链正常化是关键。特斯拉监控能源成本。

market.en: S&P 500 at 7,353.61, Nasdaq at 25,870.71. Mixed sentiment: tech on NVDA, energy on geopolitics. Inflation risk weighs on rate-sensitive sectors. Bond vigilance needed.
market.zh: 标普 500 在 7,353.61，纳斯达克在 25,870.71。情绪分化：科技看 NVDA，能源看地缘。通胀风险压制利率敏感板块。需警惕债市。

preciousMetals.en: Gold at $4,480 (+0.58%). Safe-haven demand amid Middle East tension. Inflation hedge narrative intact but yield retreat weighs. Silver, platinum follow gold dynamics.
preciousMetals.zh: 金价 4,480 美元 (+0.58%)。中东紧张局势下的避险需求。通胀对冲叙事完整，但收益率回落构成压力。白银、铂金跟随黄金。

oil.en: Oil volatile with China tankers exiting Hormuz. WTI $102, Brent $109. Trump's quick-end claim creates tactical dip but geopolitical premium persists. Supply constraints post-conflict likely.
oil.zh: 油价波动，中国油轮驶离霍尔木兹。WTI 102 美元，布伦特 109 美元。特朗普快速结束声明造成战术性回调，但地缘溢价持续。冲突后供应约束可能。

futures.en: S&P 500 futures tick higher ahead of earnings. Nasdaq led by AI chip names. Dow cautious on energy volatility. Expect mixed open.
futures.zh: 标普 500 期货在财报前小幅上扬。纳斯达克由 AI 芯片股主导。道指对能源波动谨慎。预期开盘分化。

treasury10Y.en: 10Y yield at 4.639%, down from 4.687% high. Bond vigilance needed as inflation fears resurface. FOMC minutes later today may complicate rate expectations.
treasury10Y.zh: 10 年期收益率 4.639%，从 4.687% 高位回落。通胀担忧重燃需警惕债市。今日稍后的 FOMC 纪要可能复杂化利率预期。

dxy.en: DXY stable amid mixed global risks. EUR/USD +0.05%, JPY/USD +0.03%. Oil-dollar correlation intact. Dollar safe-haven flows vs. risk-on tech.
dxy.zh: DXY 在全球混合风险下稳定。欧元/美元 +0.05%，日元/美元 +0.03%。油价美元相关性完整。美元避险流 vs. 风险偏好科技股。

oil.en: Brent $109, WTI $102. Tactical dip on peace-talk headlines but geopolitical premium embedded. Watch for Hormuz disruption or deal failure.
oil.zh: 布伦特 109 美元，WTI 102 美元。和平谈判头条下战术性回调，但地缘溢价内嵌。关注霍尔木兹中断或协议失败。

keyRisk.en: Inflation expectations from Middle East escalation. Fed's rate decision timing. Nvidia earnings outcome. Watch for deal failure or Iran IRGC retaliation.
keyRisk.zh: 中东升级导致的通胀预期。美联储决策时机。英伟达财报结果。关注协议失败或伊朗 IRGC 报复。

note.en: Geopolitics and inflation risk dominate. Tech earnings provide contrast. Energy elevated but volatile. Mixed market sentiment until Nvidia closes.
note.zh: 地缘政治和通胀风险主导。科技财报提供对比。能源高位但波动。英伟达收盘前市场情绪分化。
